name: Driving-document rule not carried over
definition: A rule stated in the driving document is not carried into the plan's task text or criterion.
question_template: Does the candidate carry this rule, including each condition and failure path? Quote the carrying sentence, or answer PROBLEM.
severity_guidance: Blocking when the dropped rule changes what the built artefact does; minor when the rule only affects wording.
known_weakness: Rules carried in words and not in identifiers; high identifier overlap hides a missing rule.
